meta.title: Chinese politics knowledge network, c. 1986-2026
meta.description: Key works and debates on Chinese politics: elite and cadre politics, central-local relations and the policy process, responsiveness, information control, contention and repression, legitimacy and nationalism, political economy, corruption and law, civil society, environment, historical legacies, the periphery and China in the world. Seeds come from this repo's papers.json; works shared with the other maps are imported from them; others are top-cited 2006-2026 articles selected via Crossref (including six China-studies journals) plus anchoring books. Direction: source (later or dependent work) -> target (earlier or anchoring work).

edge_types.builds_on: source extends or relies on target's argument or evidence
edge_types.challenges: source contests target's claim, mechanism or evidence
edge_types.qualifies: source adds a scope condition or moderating factor to target
edge_types.extends_to_new_case: source applies target's logic to a new population, period or domain
edge_types.synthesizes: source integrates target with other work
edge_types.mechanism_tested_by: source tests a mechanism implied by target

meta.verification: Repo works come from the user's Zotero library. Works shared with the other four maps keep their earlier verification. Crossref-selected works take title, authors, year, venue and DOI from Crossref records. All new anchors were found in Crossref, books mostly via published reviews or chapter records. One-line claims for non-repo works are my summaries.
